correctness.rationale: For every N>=3 connected symmetric positive weighted graph, first-step equations yield M=T tr(G)/(N-1); Sherman–Morrison gives the exact rational M(w); Q<AR follows strictly from rank N-1>=2; derivative and difference are signed explicit polynomials and prove unique/global extrema. Independently checked by 700 exact symbolic/rational assertions on five weighted graphs, not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A motivated network transport design problem receives a sharp complete and global phase classification for every connected weighted topology, including an exact no-reentrance implication, a transport-time threshold, a unique finite best conductance and a single benefit-to-harm crossover. These are actionable and are not merely restating the resistance rank-one identity.
